verdicts.title: Schur multipliers of special p-groups of rank 2
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: A group G is called special p-group of rank k if the commutator subgroup [G,G] and centre Z(G) are equal, which is elementary abelian p-group of rank k and G/[G,G] is also elementary abelian p-group. In this article we determine the Schur multiplier of special p-groups of rank 2 explicitly.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns Schur multipliers of special p-groups of rank 2, which has no interaction with ideal class groups of local rings or communication complexity rank. The only connection is the shared word 'rank,' which is used in a completely different sense.

verdicts.title: Andrews-Curtis and Nielsen equivalence relations on some infinite groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The Andrews-Curtis conjecture asserts that, for a free group $F_n$ of rank $n$ and a free basis $(x_1,...,x_n)$, any normally generating tuple $(y_1,...,y_n)$ is Andrews-Curtis equivalent to $(x_1,...,x_n)$. This equivalence corresponds to the actions of $\operatorname{Aut}F_n$ and of $F_n$ on normally generating $n$-tuples.
